deadline.value: The Fall priority deadline is January 15; applications submitted by then get the strongest consideration.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.

toefl_min.value: The department requires TOEFL iBT 79, above the graduate-school default of 71.

ielts_min.value: The department requires IELTS 6.5, above the graduate-school default of 6.0.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether an advisor is needed before admission.

funding.value: The page does not state a funding rule for admitted PhD students.
